Grab's deliveries GMV grew at the same rate in both years — 21% in FY2025 (from $11,724 million to $14,236 million) and 13% in FY2024 (from $10,365 million to $11,724 million) — so growth was actually faster in FY2025, not the same. [Grab, FY2025, p.96]; [Grab, FY2024, p.140]

- FY2025: Deliveries GMV grew 21%, from $11.7 billion in 2024 to $14.2 billion in 2025 [Grab, FY2025, p.96, p.98].
- FY2024: Deliveries GMV grew 13%, from $10.4 billion in 2023 to $11.7 billion in 2024 [Grab, FY2024, p.140, p.142].

Thus, deliveries GMV growth accelerated in FY2025 (21%) compared with FY2024 (13%), an acceleration of 8 percentage points.
